brief:
More than 530 Palestinian families have been forced from their homes in Hebron during a citywide lockdown by Israeli forces, according to Al Jazeera. The displacement occurred in the occupied West Bank city as authorities implemented the sweeping security measure.

Details on the circumstances of the forced departures and the current whereabouts of the displaced families remain unclear from available reports.
dek: More than 530 Palestinian families forced from Hebron during Israeli siege More than 530 Palestinian families have been forced from their homes in Hebron in the occupied West Bank during a citywide lockdown by Israeli forces, Al Jazeera has reported.
title: Israeli siege displaces over 530 Palestinian families in Hebron
